description: Removes one saved file from a website, then checks the remaining pages against the rules start_website returned, and returns the same report as save_website_files. Other files stay. A path that is not saved fails with no_such_file. Removing index.html leaves the website with no home page until one is saved. To delete the whole website, use delete_website.

editKey.description: The editKey start_website returned, which proves the website is the caller's. Leave it out for a website in the connected account.

path.description: The file's path from the website's root, exactly as it was saved, such as index.html, about.html or images/shop.jpg. list_website_files shows every path.

websiteId.description: The websiteId start_website returned, or one list_sites shows.

name: delete_website_file
title: Delete a website file
